description: Escenarios de cambio climático is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Los escenarios climáticos son representaciones plausibles de condiciones del clima futuro. Pueden ser producidos por una variedad de enfoques tales como modelos numéricos físicos del sistema climático, incrementando algún elemento climático en particular (IPCC, 2013). Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Its tags are calentamiento tierra, calor, cambio climático, condición climática, datos climáticos. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-05-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
